pages.title: Circulation
pages.text: $(thing)Circulation$()$(br2)The heart pushes blood through vessels that branch finer and finer; the flow in each follows the fourth power of its radius. Unlocks Perfused Tissue.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Physiology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Living Cell, 4 Redstone.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Flow through a vessel goes as the fourth power of its radius (Poiseuille). A vessel of radius r carries a base flow; write the flow Q for radius r, from a constant c.
